VTE Prophylaxis Recommendations:
• 0-1: Low risk - early mobilization
• 2: Moderate risk - mechanical prophylaxis
• 3-4: Higher risk - pharmacologic ± mechanical
• ≥5: Highest risk - pharmacologic + mechanical
Note: Individual patient factors and bleeding risk must be considered
